title: Mountain bike sabotage after Senate briefing

tellings.quote: About 3 weeks later, someone sawed through the bolt that holds my mountain bike seat on

plain: In 2023, about three weeks after he briefed people at the Senate, someone sawed through the bolt that holds the seat on his mountain bike, says Steven Greer, a guest who campaigns for the release of UFO secrets. He tells Michels this as something that happened to him: "someone sawed through the bolt that holds my mountain bike seat on." He tells it as a warning or an attempt to hurt him, which, if true, would mean someone wanted to punish him for speaking.
